ideas.pitch: A localized, battery-efficient offline mesh network protocol using ESP32 nodes and Bluetooth Low Energy that allows survivors post-collapse to broadcast SOS signals and critical medical supply inventories without internet or cellular infrastructure.
ideas.title: AetherMesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the civilization-rebuilding mission by solving foundational communication challenges, featuring a functional hardware/software demo that appeals to practical engineering judges.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first agricultural resource and seed-banking ledger designed for low-power tablets, tracking crop rotation cycles, soil nitrogen levels, and heirloom seed viability to prevent agricultural failure in a reset society.
ideas.title: VerdantOS
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of clear, measurable impact by addressing food security and sustainability, a core pillar of civilizational resilience.

ideas.pitch: A micro-grid energy distribution dashboard that monitors and dynamically throttles power allocation from localized solar arrays and kinetic generators to critical community assets like water purification pumps and field hospitals.
ideas.title: SolisGrid
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals to the long-term scalability criterion by providing an indispensable infrastructure management tool for early-stage post-collapse settlements.

ideas.pitch: A quantized, locally-hosted medical triage assistant operating entirely on offline edge hardware, translating basic symptom descriptions into standardized first-aid protocols and herbal remedy preparation guides when pharmaceutical supplies run dry.
ideas.title: ReviveMed AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors successful health-awareness applications while satisfying the hackathon's requirement for engineering solutions that function in zero-connectivity apocalypse scenarios.

ideas.pitch: An automated turbidity and heavy-metal sensor suite built on low-cost microcontrollers that tests raw collected rainwater and river sources, displaying clear green-light or red-light safety indicators for community water consumption.
ideas.title: AquaFilter IoT
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features a working IoT demo that measures critical health and survival metrics, matching the winning formula of concrete real-world utility.
